entries.name: Drake Maye
entries.summary: For now, Maye -- who suffered a fractured right fibula during a Week 10 loss to the Lions -- remains on the Patriots' 53-man roster rather than injured reserve, with coach Mike Vrabel citing the "balance" the team is hoping to strike with regard to managing its remaining designated to return from IR slots, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Luke Musgrave
entries.summary: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said Saturday that he doesn't anticipate Musgrove (neck) returning from the PUP list this season, according to NFL reporter Jason B. Hirschhorn.

entries.name: Seth McGowan
entries.summary: Colts head coach Shane Steichen said that McGowan will miss some time after injuring his hamstring in Thursday's 26-3 loss to the Texans, Stephen Holder of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: A.J. Brown
entries.summary: Brown (hamstring) wasn't spotted on the field for Tuesday's unofficial practice, Evan Lazar of the Patriots' official site reports.

entries.name: Jake Ferguson
entries.summary: Ferguson (knee/ankle) remained a non-participant in practice Tuesday, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.

entries.name: Jordan Addison
entries.summary: Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell said Monday that Addison is "progressing really well" in his recovery from thumb surgery, though the wide receiver isn't expected to be available in Week 12 versus the Falcons, Ben Goessling of The Minnesota Star Tribune reports.

entries.name: Ben Skowronek
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Bhayshul Tuten
entries.summary: Jaguars head coach Liam Coen said Tuten aggravated a right ankle injury in Sunday's 23-18 loss to the Giants, while noting that an examination Monday revealed nothing "too bad," Ryan O'Halloran of The Florida Times-Union reports.

entries.name: Bo Melton
entries.summary: Melton (thigh) is listed as questionable for Wednesday night's game against the Rams, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

entries.name: Brenen Thompson
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Brevin Jordan
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Brock Bowers
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Carson Beck
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Dallas Goedert
entries.summary: Goedert was listed as a limited participant on Monday's practice estimate due to a shin injury.

entries.name: Dalton Kincaid
entries.summary: Kincaid (thumb/ankle) was listed as a limited participant on Monday's practice estimate.

entries.name: Dareke Young
entries.summary: Young (stinger) is questionable to return to Sunday's contest against Denver.

entries.name: Denzel Boston
entries.summary: Boston didn't take part in the Browns' unofficial practice Tuesday, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Isaiah Williams
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Jared Wayne
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Jonathan Mingo
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Josh Jacobs
entries.summary: The Packers list Jacobs (finger) as questionable for Wednesday's game against the Rams, Wes Hodkiewicz of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Justin Herbert
entries.summary: Herbert entered the concussion protocol after Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Juwan Johnson
entries.summary: Saints head coach Kellen Moore said Monday that Johnson is still undergoing further medical evaluation after injuring his hamstring during Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears, Ross Jackson of WWL-TV reports.

entries.name: Kayshon Boutte
entries.summary: Boutte's hip injury he suffered in Thursday night's win over the Colts doesn't appear to be serious, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

entries.name: Keaton Mitchell
entries.summary: Mitchell (back) has re-entered Sunday's game against the Jets, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Kenneth Walker III
entries.summary: The Chiefs listed Walker (groin) as a limited participant in Tuesday's practice.

entries.name: Kyler Murray
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Noah Gray
entries.summary: Gray (ribs) was deemed a non-participant in Monday's walkthrough.

entries.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Roschon Johnson
entries.summary: Johnson (ankle) was listed as a non-participant on Monday's estimated practice report.

entries.name: Sam Darnold
entries.summary: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Darnold (quadriceps/rib) made a "good bit of progress" over the Seahawks' Week 11 bye and will start Sunday at San Francisco if he fares well during Wednesday's practice, Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Sam LaPorta
entries.summary: LaPorta (ankle) was limited at Monday's walkthrough, Nolan Bianchi of The Detroit News reports.

entries.name: Saquon Barkley
entries.summary: Barkley was listed as a limited participant on Monday's estimated practice report due to a neck injury and an illness.

entries.name: Skyy Moore
entries.summary: Moore (ankle) is listed as questionable for Wednesday night's game against the Rams, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

entries.name: Tanner McKee
entries.summary: McKee (ribs) was estimated as a limited participant on Monday's injury report.

entries.name: Will Mallory
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Will Shipley
entries.summary: Shipley (foot/illness) was estimated as a limited participant on Monday's injury report.

entries.name: Woody Marks
entries.summary: Head coach DeMeco Ryans said Monday that Marks (concussion) is "trending in the right direction," and the Texans "are hopeful to have him" for Sunday's game against the Ravens, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

entries.name: Zachariah Branch
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Alec Pierce
entries.summary: Head coach Shane Steichen said Monday that Pierce continues to rehab his left heel injury, and the wideout hasn't been ruled out for a return from injured reserve before the end of the season, Nathan Brown of The Indianapolis Star reports.

entries.name: Andrei Iosivas
entries.summary: Iosivas (thumb) was downgraded to out for Monday's game against the Commanders, Mike Petraglia of CLNSCincy.com reports.

entries.name: Caleb Lohner
entries.summary: Lohner (foot) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Raiders, Aric DiLalla of the Broncos' official site reports.

entries.name: Davante Adams
entries.summary: Adams (hamstring) has an "outside chance" to return from injured reserve for the Rams' Week 13 matchup with the Chiefs but is more likely to be activated around mid-December, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Dontayvion Wicks
entries.summary: The Eagles placed Wicks (ankle/foot) on injured reserve Saturday.

entries.name: George Holani
entries.summary: The Seahawks placed Holani (knee) on injured reserve Monday, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Jared Wiley
entries.summary: The Chiefs placed Wiley (ankle) on injured reserve Wednesday, Matt Derrick of ChiefsDigest.com reports.

entries.name: Jeremiyah Love
entries.summary: Coach Mike LaFleur said Monday that the Cardinals are still evaluating the status of Love (ankle), with the running back's earliest possible return from IR on the horizon, Bo Brack of GoPHNX.com reports.

entries.name: Jonathon Brooks
entries.summary: Brooks (groin) has been downgraded to out for Sunday's game against the Ravens.

entries.name: Lamar Jackson
entries.summary: The Ravens believe "there's a chance" that Jackson (thumb) could return for their Week 16 matchup with the Browns, assuming all goes well in his recovery from right thumb surgery, Dan Graziano of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Malik Willis
entries.summary: Head coach Jeff Hafley said Monday that, at this time, surgery to address Willis' groin/core injury is not foreseen, Joe Schad of The Palm Beach Post reports.

entries.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
entries.summary: Pittman (foot) was listed as a full participant in Tuesday's walkthrough practice.

entries.name: Puka Nacua
entries.summary: Nacua (knee/toe) is expected to be sidelined 4-to-5 months after undergoing surgery Tuesday to repair his right MCL, which means he won't be on track to return at any point during the playoffs, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Raheim Sanders
entries.summary: The Browns designated Sanders (hip) for return from injured reserve Tuesday.

entries.name: Romeo Doubs
entries.summary: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said Monday that Doubs (shoulder) may be cleared to return to practice later in the week, Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald reports.

entries.name: Terrance Ferguson
entries.summary: Rams head coach Sean McVay said Monday that Ferguson (hamstring) won't be activated from injured reserve this season and will require surgery to address the ankle injury he aggravated in Week 3, Stu Jackson of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Tyjae Spears
entries.summary: The Titans placed Spears (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

entries.name: Tyrone Tracy Jr.
entries.summary: Tracy (hamstring) could be reinstated from injured reserve when first eligible ahead of the Giants' Week 13 game against the 49ers, Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: J.K. Dobbins
entries.summary: Broncos head coach Sean Payton announced Tuesday that Dobbins has been suspended one game for conduct detrimental to the team, Chris Tomasson of The Denver Gazette reports.
